text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed translation files
        id: changed
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: lib/l10n/.*\.arb

      - name: Set up Flutter
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action@fcdb62b682dade6f0d9e0c6eae6acc647ca8c31d
        with:
          path: .fvm/fvm_config.json
          setup: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translations
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: regenerate translations"
          branch: regenerate-translations-${{ github.run_id }}
          push_options: --force

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all != '[]'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: regenerate translations"
          branch: regenerate-translations-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: "chore: regenerate translations"
          body: |
            Automated regeneration of translation files.
            Triggered by changes in translation files.
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
